text:
Marta: Heads up — Belmont Health (BLMT-1009) past due INV-2026-0421 for $54,320 (now ~45 days). Received a call: they	are short on runway and asked about breaking into installments.
Priya: Can we pull AR history + any disputed credits?
Marta: AR look: no credits, invoice untouched. 30d: $0, 60d: $0, 90d+: $54,320.
AE_Liam: Customer on a pilot for Dedicated. They said funding delay from their VC close. They want to do 3 installments.
collections-bot: Sent dunning email #2 to billing@belmonthealth.com at 2026-03-23T09:12Z.
Marta: Customer proposal: pay 35% now, 35% in 30 days, 30% in 60 days. Asked to waive $1,250 late fee entirely.
Avery: Is this account under our strategic list? do we have any upcoming billings that would be jeopardized?
Sam_Sales: Strategic. We have an SOW for infra (~$18k) due to invoice next week. AE recommends pausing provisioning if payment doesn't start.
Erika: We can do a plan but need an amendment with default reinstatement of fees and interest. I won't sign off on full fee waiver — max reduce to $500 without exec OK. If they want fee forgiveness >$750, escalate to VP Finance.
Priya: What about revenue recognition?
Marta: Finance note: defer revenue on disputed portion until at least first installment clears and ACH settles.
Marta: Draft payment plan I propose:
```
- On signing: $19,012 (35%)
- +30 days: $19,012 (35%)
- +60 days: $16,296 (30%)
- Late fee reduced to $500; interest reinstated on default
- Requirement: ACH or card on file and CFO email authorization for plan
```
AE_Liam: Customer agrees to pay first 35% by card today if we send link.
Avery: Condition approvals: 1) Signed amendment uploaded to contracts repo, 2) payment tokenized or ACH mandate captured within 48 hours, 3) halt non-essential provisioning until first settlement. Approving plan with those caveats.
Erika: I'll prep the amendment with catch-up and right-to-withdraw clause. Need CFO ack for concession >$50k.
Marta: I'll generate payment link and collections task once legal approves text.
collections-bot: Collections task created for BLMT-1009: weekly follow-up, next run 2026-03-30.
Sam_Sales: AE sent the payment link. Got a screenshot of card auth for $19,012, pending capture.
Marta: Authorization received. Will monitor for settlement.
Priya: Once settlement posts, I'll move $19,012 to cash receipts and update AR ledger; flag remaining balance.
Marta: Update: card cleared for $19,012 on 2026-03-24. Filed amendment in contracts/BLMT-1009/amendments.
Avery: Resume pilot monitoring but keep provisioning limited until second installment or explicit sales approval.
Erika: Uploaded final amendment; clause includes reinstatement of full late fees on default and 1.5% monthly interest.
Marta: Closing notes: payment plan accepted (35/35/30), fee reduced to $500, paperwork in repo, collections cadence active. If they miss +30 payment, escalate for access suspension.
Sam_Sales: Customer confirmed CFO signed plan via email. AE to attach that to contract.
collections-bot: Reminder: next payment follow-up scheduled 2026-04-23.
